Chara's thoughts started to blur, the once sharp and malevolent focus of her mind dulled by the constant assault on her senses. The realization that she was helpless, completely at Frisk’s mercy, began to sink in.

Unfortunately for her, no matter how much she tried to muster the strength to fight back, her body refused to respond. Frisk's weight on her was pressing her firmly to the ground and this relentless assault showed no signs of stopping. Her confidence was strong, but even that couldn’t protect her from the relentless onslaught of Frisk's gas.


"Round 2 goes to me. I guess it's time for the final round, wouldn't you say?"




As Frisk gets off of Chara and waits for her to respond, the stage resets the environment and becomes like snowdin for their final round. Frisk waved her hand as she smelled Chara's body covered in putrid gas.

Chara was slow to get up as the gas made her body shake a lot. Frisk can't help but giggle a little to see that Chara was just about to get dominated again. The final round was about to be someone's true defeat.

Frisk says this as her soul starts to recall times when she adapted to other souls' abilities. And now, Frisk starts to form her powers into one soul and she transforms her body. A set of rainbow wings start to sprout from her body and her eyes start to show a bright red.

Frisk starts to use powers of Patience to throw and summon cyan knives to attack Chara and make her dodge just to get met with her face smothered all over the angelic cheeks. Taking her time, Frisk decides to get even more brassy with her next attack.

Chara was thrown off from that flurry of attacks, trying to dodge them all but ultimately ending up pinned under Frisk's big booty! The impact of the fart left a crater that wide for Chara to be laid there.




As the powerful blast of Frisk's "Big Bang Fart of Determination" echoed across the battlefield, the sheer force of it created a massive crater, leaving Chara helplessly sprawled at the bottom. The smell was overwhelming, choking her senses, and any remaining defiance she had was quickly fading. Frisk floated above the crater, her rainbow wings shimmering in the icy air of Snowdin, as she descended slowly, her expression both determined and calm.




Chara, barely conscious, tried to move, but her body refused to obey. She was utterly defeated, and she knew it. The overwhelming stench clinging to her was a constant reminder of her humiliating loss. Frisk landed beside her, her soft yet firm expression carrying the weight of her final victory.




"It's over, Chara," Frisk stated, her voice gentle yet resolute. "You’ve lost. And now, it's time for me to receive my reward..."




With a flick of her wrist, Frisk used the last of her power to shrink Chara down to a tiny size, barely a few inches tall. Chara's eyes widened in fear and disbelief as she realized what was happening, but there was nothing she could do to stop it. She was now completely at Frisk's mercy.




Frisk reached down, plucking the tiny Chara from the ground and holding her up to her face.

With that, Frisk turned around and carefully wedged the shrunken Chara between her massive, sweaty cheeks, pressing her deep into the crack. The fit was snug, and Chara was trapped, her tiny body smothered between Frisk's cheeks, her face pressed firmly against Frisk's puckering hole.

As the last echoes of the fart faded away, Frisk sighed in satisfaction, savoring her victory.




"Well, that takes care of that," she sighed, her voice laced with a mix of relief and triumph. "Now, I think it's time to head home. I've got a bean burrito with my name on it."




With Chara securely trapped between her cheeks, Frisk strutted away from the battlefield, her victory complete. Chara, once a powerful and feared adversary, was now nothing more than a permanent fixture in Frisk's life, doomed to a fate of endless torment and humiliation.




The contest was over, and Frisk had emerged victorious in every possible way.
